notes: §1985:XII.2.4 GR11: "the indicator area of the introduced line contains the same character as the line on which the text being replaced begins, unless that line contains a hyphen, in which case the introduced line contains a space"; a literal continued onto an introduced line gets a hyphen. FixedFormConverter turns a D line into the DebugLineCarrier and joins continuation lines, so the logical text carries only the debugging indicator; ApplyReplacements decides the replaced line's kind and IntroducedText writes the carrier on every line a replacement introduces when the replaced text begins on a debugging line, and DebuggingLineRewriter hides them without WITH DEBUGGING MODE; a literal is never split in the logical text, which is the hyphen continuation. Probes p11a, p10a, p11b, p11c as before (witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-11). Since kb/Work PB5471 (landed) an operand that is not pseudo-text takes the replaced line's indicator on every line it introduces at every edition (only debugging lines "within pseudo-text-2" stay debugging lines, GR9 and §2002:7.1.2.3 GR13): an identifier-2 the COPY statement writes over a debugging line (q15: A1 / D OF B1 OF C2) is a source line in the resultant program and prints [Z] with and without WITH DEBUGGING MODE (witness pb5471-identifier-2-over-debugging-line); the word-2 control q15w still prints [Q].

next.reason: 1985: "the indicator area of the introduced line contains the same character as the line on which the text being replaced begins"; 2023: "GR-7.2.3.4-11: The resultant text after replacement shall be in logical free-form reference format.". 2023 makes COPY's resultant text logical free-form, which has no indicator area or continuation lines. The rule on indicator content and hyphen continuation of introduced lines is gone.
